artworks.title: Garçon!... garçon!... allons il est décidé...
artworks.description: There is a group of five people in a dining setting. The focus is on four seated individuals at a small table with a tablecloth. They are shown from the waist up. One man looks disgruntled and sits with his arms crossed, facing away from the table. Another man is seated across from him, raising his clenched fist. A woman is sitting with her hands folded in her lap. The individuals have exaggerated facial features, long noses, and distinct profiles. They wear simple clothing, with one person wearing an apron. A pitcher and cup are on the table. A waiter is standing to the left, holding a piece of paper. A hat and coat hang on hooks. The room is illuminated from above, casting shadows on the walls.

artworks.title: Ayant eu la facheuse idée d'aller... en mer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people on a boat. The scene shows several individuals experiencing seasickness on the deck of a sailboat. One person is leaning over the side of the boat, another is sitting slumped with a fallen hat nearby, and others are lying on the deck looking distressed. The drawing includes a tilted mast and sails to show the boat's motion, and other boats sailing calmly in the distance on the horizon. The artist uses exaggerated facial expressions and postures to convey humor and discomfort.

artworks.title: Arrivée dans une ville trop hospitalière...
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing showing a crowded city scene. There are various animated figures with exaggerated emotions, conveying a sense of busyness and chaos. In the center, a man in plaid trousers and a large hat is surrounded by others vying for his attention. Papers and signs with labels like "HOTEL" and "RESTAURANT" are scattered on the floor. The characters have exaggerated expressions, adding a comical and satirical tone to the scene. The drawing uses heavy lines and shading to create depth.

artworks.title: Parisiens recevant un grain...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing in a rainstorm on a rocky beach. The figures are caricatured with exaggerated features and are wearing hats. The rain falls diagonally across the image. The figures have comical expressions as they struggle against the wind and rain. In the background, there are hints of the sea with waves and distant sails barely visible through the rain. The ground is rocky and wet, suggesting they are on the shoreline. The overall mood is satirical, capturing the experience of being caught in bad weather. The strokes and lines are bold and expressive.

artworks.title: Parisiens surpris par la marée...
artworks.description: This drawing depicts figures reacting to an incoming tide. The scene is set at a beach, with a group of three figures surprised by rising water levels. The central figure on the left wears a tall hat and looks through a telescope. Next to him, another figure appears agitated with arms raised. A third figure in the background appears to be waving or signaling with both hands near his hat. The backdrop shows a seascape with waves and distant ships.

artworks.title: Autre émotion maritime
artworks.description: The image depicts two people standing on a rocky beach overlooking the ocean. The man is on the left, facing the ocean with his back slightly turned. He has exaggerated facial features and dark, wavy hair. He is wearing a long-sleeve shirt, striped pants, and a scarf. Beside him, the woman faces the ocean with a partially turned profile view and her head covered. She wears a dark top and patterned skirt, holding onto the man's arm. In the background, the calm sea extends to the horizon with a floating black hat. The sky has a few clouds.

artworks.title: Le Retour a Paris
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals sitting in a room setting. The left figure is seated in a reclined position on a cushioned chair, holding a piece of paper. The right figure, seated similarly, leans back with eyes closed and mouth open. A round table with a teapot and cup is between them, with a wallpapered wall and framed portraits in the background.

artworks.title: Mars and Diana [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in full view. The person on the left is slightly turned to the right, with their right arm raised and pointing. The person on the right faces left, holding a circular shield. The figure on the left has wavy, long hair pulled back, and the figure on the right has short, curly hair mostly covered by a helmet with a large plume. The left figure is draped in a flowing garment that exposes much of their body, including their legs, and has a face motif at their waist. The figure on the right wears detailed armor with a breastplate featuring a face motif, a skirt-like piece, and intricate leg armor. The background is lightly sketched, with minimal detail beyond the figures.

artworks.title: Kneeling Woman [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a slightly leaning position with arms raised outwards. The figure's face is faintly drawn, with long hair cascading over the shoulders. The person is wearing a long flowing garment with loose sleeves. The background is blank or lightly smudged.

artworks.title: Ambush (L'Embuscade)
artworks.description: The image shows a dense woodland scene with trees and vegetation filling the space. The style is characterized by an etching technique, creating texture and depth. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, giving a vintage appearance. The scene includes uneven terrain with scattered vegetation and dense trees reaching into the sky.

artworks.title: Stand of Alders (Le Bouquet d'aunes)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverscape with a low horizon, featuring water meeting a distant riverbank with trees and what looks like a windmill. A prominent tree with thin branches spans diagonally across the scene, surrounded by smaller shrubs closer to the viewer. Delicate and detailed brushstrokes or etch lines depict natural elements with a soft, sketch-like quality. The monochromatic sepia color palette gives the image a warm, vintage feel. The sky contains lines indicating movement, and the composition evokes a sense of calm and tranquility.

artworks.title: Deer (Les Cerfs)
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene with deer gathered near trees from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is not visible, and the focus is on the immediate landscape. Fine and intricate etching lines create a textured depiction of the foliage and animals. The color palette is monochromatic brown, giving a warm, sepia-toned appearance. The deer are shown in delicate detail amidst dense underbrush, and the trees converge towards a light central area, providing depth to the image.

artworks.title: Banks of a River (Bords de Riviere)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with trees and water, depicted using intricate line work with a monochromatic sepia color palette. The scene includes foliage, tree trunks, and distant structures or vegetation. Close to the viewer, there are detailed plants and grasses framing the composition, with two small figures for scale.

artworks.title: Le Cerisier de la Plante a Biau
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawing with intricate details viewed from a ground-level perspective. The horizon is low, showing distant trees and suggesting a vast outdoor space. Rocks and two trees are featured, creating a natural arch. The artist's fine lines and stippling capture the texture of the foliage and rocks, adding depth and realism. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey and black. The scene includes smaller trees and shrubbery, blending into the distant view.

artworks.title: En Foret a Breau
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a dense forest from ground level. The horizon is obscured by tall trees with interwoven branches and leaves. The style features detailed etching with precise lines creating a rich texture. The color palette is sepia tones. The foreground has various plants with detailed foliage, leading to the thick forest in the background.

artworks.title: Squelettes et Ecorches
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anatomical figures displaying skeletal and muscular systems alongside mythical or allegorical elements. The image features two standing skeletons; one at the left and one towards the right. Next to the left skeleton stands a muscular figure with a crown of laurels. On the right, another muscular figure stands, turned away to reveal its muscular and vascular details. The left skeleton is also holding hands with a partly hidden skeletal figure. Below these figures is a scene depicting a collection of objects and busts. The use of line work and shading emphasizes the contours and forms of the anatomical structures.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with the Infant John the Baptist
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with a man and a child. The woman sits on the ground holding a child on her lap. She has delicate facial features and braided hair, wearing a long gown with a sash. Next to her are a pitcher and another container on the ground. The man stands behind her, leaning on a staff, with wavy hair and a beard, wearing a robe. The child besides the woman plays with another child, holding a cross. A cat is seen on a window ledge to the left. The setting is outdoors, with a tree trunk in the middle and hills and buildings in the background.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Fountains"
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate, classical structure positioned slightly to the right of center, with a plaque featuring inscriptions. The structure has intricate carvings and decorations. Stone elements are scattered on the ground with engravings. Trees and foliage surround the scene. In the distance, two small human figures stand amidst the ruins. The artwork uses an etching technique with detailed line work and a monochromatic palette. The horizon line is suggested by the sky visible through the trees.

artworks.title: Vase Supported by Intertwined Serpents
artworks.description: The image shows a large, intricately designed urn or vase placed on top of a sculpted pedestal. The urn is adorned with elaborate decorations and is surrounded by smaller decorative elements. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of gray and black. In the foreground, the urn is the focal point, while the background features dense trees and crumbling architectural elements like arches and walls.

artworks.title: Vase Supported by Two Sphinxes
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a large ornate structure and an urn. The image depicts a massive stone structure with intricately carved columns and beams covered in detailed reliefs and designs. In the foreground, there is a large, elegantly carved urn ornamented with classical motifs and supported by sculptural elements resembling figures or animals. It is positioned on a platform with decorative friezes and rosettes. A pathway runs through the scene, lined with trees and foliage, adding natural beauty to the architectural setting. The drawing conveys a sense of grandeur and reverence, reminiscent of classical antiquity.

artworks.title: Vase with Two Fantastic Heads
artworks.description: The image shows a large ornate urn in a natural setting with sepia tones. The urn is decorated with intricate patterns and figures. Additional stone elements and foliage are visible in the scene.

artworks.title: Vase Supported by a Base with Three  Grotesque Faces
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate urn or sculptural monument set in a landscape. The object is detailed and positioned prominently, dominating the scene. The horizon is visible alongside surrounding vegetation. The brushwork is detailed, portraying textures and shadows on the monument and trees. The color palette is primarily sepia or brown. Various trees frame the edges of the scene. The sky is muted, emphasizing the monument's design.

artworks.title: Return to the Fold
artworks.medium: brown and black chalk heightened with white on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple animals and figures engaged in pastoral activities. The drawing style features fine lines, shading for texture, and motion captured through brisk brushstrokes. The color palette consists of earthy tones on a natural buff background. A variety of animals, a figure, possibly a shepherd, and a woman holding a basket are shown in the scene, with a hint of an arched stone structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Francois de Villemontee
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to his left. He has a serene expression, shoulder-length wavy hair, and a groomed mustache and goatee. He wears a formal robe with a wide white collar. An octagonal frame surrounds him with inscriptions, and the background has finely etched lines. The inscription outside the frame adds a decorative touch.
